page_title: SAS 3-1 UDI | Sassuolo v Udinese 28/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Daniele Perenzoni has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
90+2' Lennon Miller (Udinese) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
90+1' Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo) attempts to find Domenico Berardi with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Arijanet Muric intercepts the ball.
86' Substitution. Andrea Pinamonti walks off the pitch and Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo) comes on as a substitute.
85' The fouls committed statistics – 4:19.
84' Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
84' Half-chance! Sandi Lovric (Udinese) plays a pass into the box, but Arijanet Muric reacts well to snuff out the attack.
83' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
83' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Udinese.
81' 3 - 1 Goal! Alieu Fadera produces a brilliant lofted pass and Edoardo Iannoni (Sassuolo) gets on the end of it to finish with a header into an empty net. The score is 3:1.
80' Substitution. Sandi Lovric (Udinese) replaces Arthur Atta.
80' Here comes a substitution. Ismael Kone is given a rest as he is replaced by Edoardo Iannoni (Sassuolo).
79' Here is a change. Sebastian Walukiewicz is going off and Fabio Grosso gives the last tactical orders to Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo).
76' That will be all from Nicolo Zaniolo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Idrissa Gueye (Udinese).

73' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it low towards the middle of the target, but Arijanet Muric pulled off a nice save and to stop the attempt.
73' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance low towards the middle of the goal, but Arijanet Muric is alert and makes a decent save.
73' Arthur Atta (Udinese) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
72' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) jumps into a tackle and Daniele Perenzoni signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Udinese.
69' Great ball in from Sebastian Walukiewicz. Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the left post.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alessandro Zanoli departs the field of play to be replaced by Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese).
66' Keinan Davis (Udinese) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
65' 5:9 – the total goal attempt statistics. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 2:3.
61' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aster Vranckx trots off the pitch and is replaced by Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo).
58' Fabio Grosso prepares a substitution. Armand Lauriente is replaced by Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo).
57' Ooh that was close! Oumar Solet (Udinese) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
57' Udinese get a corner.

56' 2 - 1 Arthur Atta fires in a promising shot which ricochets off the goalkeeper back to Keinan Davis (Udinese) inside the box. He releases a quick shot into the bottom right corner. The score is now 2:1.
54' Keinan Davis (Udinese) does well inside the box to bring down a pass from Lennon Miller. He gets away a decent shot but it creeps just past the right post.
53' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
51' The Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Daniele Perenzoni rules it out for a foul.
50' Arthur Atta floats in a cross for Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese), whose header from near the penalty spot is really poor and floats high over the bar.
48' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Jakub Piotrowski is replaced by Lennon Miller (Udinese).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Kosta Runjaic probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Matteo Palma. He is replaced by Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese).
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+1' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is caught offside once again.
45' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' The Udinese players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Daniele Perenzoni. NO PENALTY!
40' Celebrations by Udinese are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
39' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) makes a rough challenge and Daniele Perenzoni blows his whistle for a foul. Udinese are awarded a penalty kick!
39' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.

39' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The referee blows his whistle, Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
38' Oumar Solet (Udinese) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
38' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.

37' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
36' The ball is cleared after Oumar Solet (Udinese) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
34' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:3. 2:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
34' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
33' Daniele Perenzoni has a clear sight and sees a foul from Matteo Palma (Udinese). Sassuolo will take a free kick near the side line.
31' Arthur Atta (Udinese) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
31' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
29' NO PENALTY! Referee Daniele Perenzoni has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Udinese players are incensed.
26' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Udinese using VAR. Let's see what happens.

26' Referee Daniele Perenzoni sees the trip by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. PENALTY to Udinese! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
24' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
24' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Udinese.
22' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) sprays a pass out to Keinan Davis, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
21' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
18' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
17' Sassuolo take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
16' The percentage of ball possession is – 59:41.

12' 2 - 0 Goal! Armand Lauriente produces a great pass that finds Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
10' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Daniele Perenzoni to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Sassuolo players can finally celebrate.
10' The Sassuolo players halt their celebrations as referee Daniele Perenzoni makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
8' 1 - 0 GOAL! Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) runs onto a pass from Domenico Berardi after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 1:0.
7' A dangerous towering header by Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
7' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

6' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save. Udinese force a corner. They send men into the box.

6' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Aster Vranckx collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
6' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is penalised for holding. Daniele Perenzoni signals a set piece.
4' Great teamplay by Sassuolo as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
3' Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Sassuolo will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Daniele Perenzoni.
